Build a signed Raspberry Pi 4/CM4 or Pi 5 A/B release with a verified root from
a prepared Debian root filesystem.

## Inputs

| Name                 | Kind      | Description                                                                                                       |
| -------------------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `rootfs`             | directory | Prepared root filesystem implementing the core verified-root boot contract.                                       |
| `boot`               | directory | Raspberry Pi firmware tree containing start4.elf, fixup4.dat, DTBs, and overlays.                                 |
| `config`             | directory | Layer configuration partition contents.                                                                           |
| `boot-public-key`    | file      | PEM-encoded RSA-2048 public key matching the Raspberry Pi boot signing key.                                       |
| `bundle-certificate` | file      | Single PEM-encoded RSA X.509 end-entity signer certificate issued directly by the trusted root. No intermediates. |

## Parameters

| Name               | Default                                                                     | Description                                                                                |
| ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `kernel-version`   | `""`                                                                        | Exact installed kernel version. Empty selects the unique matching version.                 |
| `kernel-flavor`    | `"rpi-v8"`                                                                  | Required installed kernel version suffix.                                                  |
| `cmdline-extra`    | `""`                                                                        | Additional authenticated kernel arguments.                                                 |
| `panic-timeout`    | `10`                                                                        | Kernel panic reboot delay in seconds. Zero leaves the system stopped.                      |
| `boot-config`      | `"[all]\narm_64bit=1\nkernel=kernel8.img\ninitramfs initrd followkernel\n"` | Contents of config.txt inside the signed boot image. Must select kernel8.img and initrd.   |
| `signing-time`     | `""`                                                                        | Signing time as Unix seconds in a string. Empty uses the build source epoch.               |
| `config-size`      | `0`                                                                         | Configuration partition capacity in bytes. Zero sizes automatically with a 64 MiB minimum. |
| `boot-size`        | `0`                                                                         | Boot partition capacity in bytes. Zero sizes automatically with a 256 MiB minimum.         |
| `boot-image-size`  | `0`                                                                         | Signed boot image capacity in bytes. Zero sizes it from its contents.                      |
| `root-compression` | `"none"`                                                                    | SquashFS compression of the root filesystem, such as zstd or xz, or none.                  |
| `disk-size`        | `0`                                                                         | Factory disk capacity in bytes. Zero sizes the disk from its partitions.                   |

## Outputs

| Name             | Artifact Source                                         |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `image`          | `{"rule":{"node":"release","output":"image"}}`          |
| `bundle`         | `{"rule":{"node":"release","output":"bundle"}}`         |
| `bundle-hash`    | `{"rule":{"node":"release","output":"bundle-hash"}}`    |
| `boot-image`     | `{"rule":{"node":"release","output":"boot-image"}}`     |
| `boot-signature` | `{"rule":{"node":"release","output":"boot-signature"}}` |
| `root-hash`      | `{"rule":{"node":"release","output":"root-hash"}}`      |
| `hash-offset`    | `{"rule":{"node":"release","output":"hash-offset"}}`    |
| `data-size`      | `{"rule":{"node":"release","output":"data-size"}}`      |

## Secrets

Required secret bindings: `boot-key`, `bundle-key`. Secret changes invalidate
cached outputs.

## Execution

Composes other rules into a build graph.

## Behavior

Build a Raspberry Pi 4/CM4 or Pi 5 A/B release with a verified root from a
prepared Debian ARM64 root. By default, this wrapper selects one installed
kernel whose version ends in `rpi-v8`, generates its initrd with
`core/initrd-debian`, and passes those artifacts to
[`core/image-rpi-verified`](../image-rpi-verified/).

Raspberry Pi's `rpi-v8` kernel supports both Pi 4 and Pi 5 with 4 KiB pages. The
firmware tree must contain device trees for the target board. See the
[Raspberry Pi kernel documentation](https://www.raspberrypi.com/documentation/computers/linux_kernel.html).

Prepare the layer with
[`core/debian-rpi-verified-setup`](../../recipes/debian-rpi-verified-setup/) and
configure trusted update signers in `/etc/rugix/ctrl.toml` through a project
recipe. On first boot, Rugix Ctrl completes the factory layout through native
bootstrap and uses its built-in `rpi-tryboot` flow. The wrapper consumes the
root and firmware tree without modifying them.

Set `kernel-version` when multiple matching kernels exist; its empty default
requires a unique matching kernel. `kernel-flavor` selects the required
installed kernel version suffix and defaults to `rpi-v8`. The selected kernel
and firmware tree must support the target board. Automatic capacity defaults,
optional size overrides, boot settings, remaining release inputs, signing
policy, and outputs match the generic Raspberry Pi composition.

## Example

For example, select the wrapper in a system definition:

```toml
[systems.rpi]
layer = "rpi"
architecture = "arm64"

[systems.rpi.rules.release]
uses = "core/image-debian-rpi-verified"
parameters.cmdline-extra = "console=serial0,115200 console=tty1"
inputs.boot-public-key = { path = "keys/rpi.pub" }
inputs.bundle-certificate = { path = "keys/bundle.crt" }
secrets.boot-key = { path = "keys/rpi.key" }
secrets.bundle-key = { path = "keys/bundle.key" }

[systems.rpi.outputs]
"system.img" = { rule = { node = "release", output = "image" } }
"system.rugixb" = { rule = { node = "release", output = "bundle" } }
"system.rugixb-hash" = { rule = { node = "release", output = "bundle-hash" } }
```

Bakery supplies the built layer's `rootfs`, `boot`, and `config` trees. Run
`./run-bakery bake system rpi --release-version v1`.
